newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Mustek says talks discontinued.
newsitem.headline: Mustek says talks discontinued.

text.p: Mustek Ltd said on Friday that the talks referred to in an earlier cautionary had been discontinued and that shareholders therefore no longer needed to exercise caution in their sharedealings.

Following a cautionary on June 17 Mustek shares rose to a new year high. Dealers at the time said that there were rumours that the firm may be talking to investment group Baobab about a possible link-up with Voicematrix.
Baobab recently bought 25.1 percent of the specialist voice processing firm.
In February Baobab said it would distribute its entire interest in Mustek to its shareholders by way of a renounceable share offer.
